systemSettings.title: System Settings
systemSettings.description: Global settings for the application including third-party API configurations initialized/modified by administrators.

id.description: Must be 'system' to isolate global config settings under a single document.

nvidiaNimKey.description: NVIDIA NIM API key used to query build.nvidia.com server-side.

oxapayKey.description: Merchant API Key from oxapay.com console used to create billing charges.

pricingPlan.title: Pricing Plan
pricingPlan.description: A customized tier plan created by admin and purchasable in INR currency.

id.description: Unique identifier of the subscription plan.

priceINR.description: Cost of subscription in Indian Rupees (INR).

queriesLimit.description: Number of allowed NVIDIA NIM AI responses (e.g. 50, 1000, or -1 for unlimited).

description.description: Summary of plan benefits shown to prospective buyers.

userProfile.title: User Profile
userProfile.description: Information regarding signed-up website users and their current subscription plans.

id.description: Firebase Authentication User UID matching google-auth-id.

email.description: Identified Google Sign-in email address of the user.

planId.description: Active pricingPlan ID, or 'free' by default.

queriesCount.description: Queries consumed so far under active plan.

chatSession.title: Chat Session
chatSession.description: Historical chat logs corresponding to Aurum AI interactions.

userId.description: The UID associated with the profile owning this chat conversation.

messages.description: List of sequentially logged chat bubbles: {role: 'user'|'assistant', content: string, timestamp: number}.

billingTransaction.title: Billing Transaction
billingTransaction.description: Detailed log tracking Oxapay payments initiated and verified status transitions.

id.description: Unique transaction key (often matches internal tracker UID or Oxapay trackId).

userId.description: UID of user who initiated payment.

planId.description: PricingPlan ID intended for upgrade after payment completes.

planName.description: Name of price plan associated with the order.

trackId.description: Returned invoice identifier tracker generated by Oxapay.

payUrl.description: Secure payment redirect address from Oxapay.

coupon.title: Coupon Code
coupon.description: Discount coupons setup by administrators that are usable on specific plans or all plans.

code.description: The coupon code (e.g. FREEAURUM, WELCOME50) in uppercase.

discount.description: The discount value. E.g. 50 or 100 for percentage, or fixed amount.

type.description: The coupon type: percentage discount or fixed currency discount.

planId.description: Allowed plan ID (e.g. 'plan_pro') or 'all' if usable across any tier.

active.description: Toggle to enable or disable active application of the code.

compiledSite.title: Compiled Website
compiledSite.description: Multi-page front-end responsive app created by Aurum AI loop.

prompt.description: The detailed specifications prompt supplied to configure custom UI design.

title.description: A shortened human-readable title generated for easy browsing.

creditsSpent.description: Total Priority Credits deducted on request launch.

settings.description: Isolates administrator keys such as NIM and Oxapay secrets under key 'system' document.

plans.description: Tiers configured by the admin to upgrade chat capabilities.

users.description: User info tracking logins and membership levels.

coupons.description: Promotional discounts registered for subscription checkouts.

sites.description: Compiled front-end website records stored securely by user.
